profiles.shortDescription: Marden Edwards designs and manufactures wrapping systems for packaged goods. Its equipment range covers overwrapping, shrink wrapping, film banding and case wrapping for industrial production lines.
fullDescription: Marden Edwards' official site presents a packaging-machinery manufacturer focused on film-wrapping processes.
The documented portfolio includes overwrappers, shrink wrappers, banding machines and case-wrapping systems configured for sectors such as consumer goods, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and tobacco.

profiles.shortDescription: Marel develops equipment, integrated systems and software for food processing. Its published portfolio supports poultry, meat, fish, prepared-food, pet-food and related processing operations.
fullDescription: JBT Marel's official product directory identifies Marel equipment and systems for primary, secondary and further food processing.
The range covers handling, cutting, deboning, portioning, forming, coating, cooking, weighing, grading, inspection, packing, labelling, water treatment and process-control software.

profiles.shortDescription: Mark Andy manufactures printing and finishing equipment for labels and flexible packaging. Its range includes flexographic and digital presses, converting systems and pressroom products.
fullDescription: Mark Andy's official site documents equipment for narrow- and mid-web label and packaging production.
The portfolio includes flexographic presses, hybrid and digital printing platforms, inspection and rewinding equipment, finishing systems, workflow software and related print-room supplies.

profiles.shortDescription: Marx Digital Manufacturing provides contract manufacturing and machine-building services. Its capabilities include CNC machining, fabrication, automation, mechanical design and assembly.
fullDescription: Marx Digital Manufacturing's official site identifies a manufacturing business that supports engineered parts, assemblies and production equipment.
Its documented capabilities include CNC milling and turning, metal fabrication, automated-system design and build, mechanical engineering, assembly and related production support.

profiles.shortDescription: Reinhausen develops equipment and digital systems for regulating power transformers and electricity networks. Its portfolio covers tap changers, voltage regulation, power-quality solutions and transformer asset management.
fullDescription: Reinhausen's official corporate site confirms that Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen GmbH now operates as Reinhausen GmbH.

The published portfolio includes on-load and de-energized tap changers, transformer monitoring and control, voltage-regulation systems, power-quality equipment, high-voltage composite insulators and services for transformer fleets.

profiles.shortDescription: Maselli Misure designs and manufactures in-line and laboratory analysers for liquid-process quality control. Its measurement technologies include refractometry and optical analysis for food, beverage and other process applications.
fullDescription: Maselli Misure's official company page identifies an Italian instrumentation manufacturer founded in 1948 and headquartered in Parma.

Its analyzers support in-line and laboratory measurements such as concentration, refractive index, colour and other quality parameters, together with sampling and analysis systems for process control.

profiles.shortDescription: MATHESON supplies industrial, specialty and electronics gases together with gas-handling equipment. Its equipment range includes regulators, manifolds, valves, flow devices, purifiers, detection systems and gas cabinets.
fullDescription: MATHESON's official site documents gas products and equipment for laboratories, manufacturing plants and electronics processes.

The published offering covers packaged, bulk and specialty gases, gas-delivery and changeover systems, pressure and flow control, purification, detection, monitoring and on-site gas-generation solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: MAUTING develops and manufactures thermal-processing equipment for food production. Its range includes smoking, cooking, baking, cooling and climate chambers with smoke-generation, transport and control systems.
fullDescription: MAUTING's official product directory documents chamber-based processing technology for meat, poultry, fish, cheese, plant-based foods and pet food.
The portfolio includes smoking and climate chambers, cooking and cooling systems, boiling kettles, smoke generators, handling systems, emission-reduction equipment and process controls.

profiles.shortDescription: Mavitec designs and builds process systems for rendering, gasification, manure treatment and food-waste depackaging. Its group combines animal by-product processing, environmental and green-energy technologies.
fullDescription: Mavitec Group's official site documents complete systems and equipment for rendering animal by-products.
Its business units also provide gasification solutions for manure and other biomass streams, plus depackaging and separation systems that recover organic material from packaged food waste.

profiles.shortDescription: MAXIMATOR develops and manufactures high-pressure components and engineered pressure systems. Its portfolio includes air-driven pumps, gas boosters, air amplifiers, valves, fittings, tubing and test systems.
fullDescription: MAXIMATOR's official site presents a German manufacturer focused on high-pressure hydraulics and pneumatics.

The documented range covers liquid pumps, gas boosters and compressors, air amplifiers, high-pressure valves and fittings, hydraulic units, pressure-generation systems and equipment for testing and hydrogen applications.

profiles.shortDescription: MAXON is a Honeywell brand for industrial combustion equipment. Its portfolio includes gas and oil burners, low-emission burners, shut-off and flow-control valves, and combustion-system components.
fullDescription: Honeywell's official thermal-solutions site identifies MAXON as an industrial combustion brand within its current portfolio.

The documented range includes line, duct, immersion and other process burners, gas and oil firing equipment, safety shut-off and control valves, actuators and related fuel-and-air delivery components.

profiles.shortDescription: Mayfran develops conveying and filtration systems for metalworking, recycling and manufacturing processes. Its range covers chip conveyors, coolant filtration, scrap handling and engineered material-transfer systems.
fullDescription: Mayfran's official site documents motion and material-handling solutions for machining and industrial production.

The portfolio includes hinge-belt and other chip conveyors, coolant-filtration systems, chip processing, stamping-scrap conveyors, solid-waste handling and specialized conveyors for food and additional industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Mayser develops tactile and non-contact safety technology for machinery, vehicles and automated systems. Its range includes safety edges, mats, bumpers, sensors, transmission systems and control units.
fullDescription: Mayser's official site identifies safety technology as one of the group's core divisions.

The published portfolio covers pressure-sensitive safety edges, miniature anti-pinch sensors, safety mats and steps, bumpers, non-contact detection, signal-transmission systems and monitoring control units.

profiles.shortDescription: MBA Instruments manufactures process instrumentation for point-level and conductivity measurement. Its devices serve bulk-solid silos and mineral-oil or fuel measurement applications.
fullDescription: MBA Instruments' official product directory documents rotary-paddle, vibrating-paddle and membrane point-level devices for powders, granulates and other bulk materials.
The company also produces stationary and portable conductivity meters for light mineral oils and fuels, together with calibration and application support.

profiles.shortDescription: MBS designs and manufactures tubular heat exchangers for hygienic and industrial processes. Its portfolio includes product-to-product, sanitary, pharmaceutical and scraped-surface configurations.
fullDescription: MBS's official product directory documents tubular heat-transfer equipment for food, beverage, pharmaceutical and industrial media.
The range includes plate-and-tube, multi-tube sanitary, cross-flow industrial, pharmaceutical and scraped-surface heat exchangers engineered for different viscosities and process duties.

profiles.shortDescription: McCloskey International manufactures mobile equipment for crushing, screening, washing and material stockpiling. Its range serves aggregates, mining, recycling and construction-material processing.
fullDescription: McCloskey International's official site documents a complete range of mobile crushers, screeners, stackers, trommels and washing systems.
The portfolio includes jaw, cone and impact crushers, tracked screening plants, wheeled and tracked stackers, trommels, rinsers, sand screws, bucket wheels and coarse-material washers.

profiles.shortDescription: Mecair is part of Pentair's Goyen Mecair portfolio for dust-collector cleaning and industrial pneumatics. Its products include diaphragm pulse valves, pilot valves, filter-cleaning controllers and pneumatic solenoid valves.
fullDescription: Pentair's official Goyen Mecair site identifies Mecair product lines within its current dust-collection portfolio.

The documented range covers threaded, dresser-nut, manifold and flanged pulse-jet valves, pilot enclosures, filter-cleaning controls and industrial pneumatic solenoid valves for air and fluid handling.

profiles.shortDescription: MECOF is an EMCO brand for large milling and machining centres. Its portfolio covers gantry, travelling-column and high-speed machines for complex precision components.
fullDescription: EMCO's official MECOF product surface documents large-format milling machines for general engineering, mould and die, aerospace and power-generation work.
The current range includes gantry and floor-type machines with multi-axis milling heads, high-speed configurations and machines designed for large, geometrically complex workpieces.

profiles.shortDescription: MEDENUS develops and manufactures gas pressure-control and safety equipment. Its product range includes regulators, filters, safety shut-off valves and relief valves for gas installations.
fullDescription: MEDENUS's official site presents a German manufacturer of gas pressure-regulating technology.
The documented portfolio includes gas pressure regulators, gas filters, safety shut-off valves, safety relief valves, pilot systems and accessories for industrial and utility gas-pressure stations.

profiles.shortDescription: Meech develops static-control, web-cleaning and compressed-air equipment for manufacturing processes. Its systems manage electrostatic charge, surface contamination and industrial air usage.
fullDescription: Meech's official site documents equipment for neutralising, generating and measuring static electricity in industrial applications.
The portfolio also includes contact and non-contact web-cleaning systems, ionised-air cleaning, air curtains, blow-off and cooling devices, and related controllers and monitoring equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: MEGATRON develops sensors, industrial joysticks and electronic components for machine and device design. Its portfolio includes potentiometers, encoders, linear sensors, load cells and human-machine interface products.
fullDescription: MEGATRON's official product directory documents mechatronic components for measuring position, angle and force and for manual machine control.
The range includes rotary potentiometers and encoders, linear position sensors, load cells, industrial joysticks, panel encoders, resistors, signal amplifiers and configurable electronic components.

profiles.shortDescription: MEIDINGER develops and manufactures industrial fans for demanding gases and operating conditions. Its range includes centrifugal, axial, jet and application-specific fan systems.
fullDescription: MEIDINGER's official site documents custom fan solutions for conveying air and gases in industrial processes.

The portfolio includes centrifugal, axial, jet and special fans designed for corrosive, explosive, toxic, abrasive or temperature-critical media, together with accessories and engineered configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Meister Abrasives develops precision grinding and dressing tools for industrial machining. Its products use vitrified, hybrid, resin and electroplated bonding technologies for high-accuracy processes.
fullDescription: Meister Abrasives' official site documents superabrasive tools for precision grinding and dressing applications.

The range includes CBN and diamond grinding wheels, fine-grinding and honing tools, stationary and rotary dressers, and application-specific tool systems for bearing, automotive, fuel-injection and other precision components.

profiles.shortDescription: Meler develops adhesive application and coating systems for industrial production. Its range includes hot-melt melters, heated hoses, applicators, pumps, controls and complete gluing installations.
fullDescription: Meler's official site documents equipment for melting, transporting, metering and applying industrial adhesives.

The portfolio includes tank and drum melters, hot-melt hoses, automatic and manual applicators, pumping and dosing equipment, coating heads, controls and engineered systems for packaging and product assembly.

profiles.shortDescription: Memmert manufactures controlled-atmosphere equipment for laboratories and industrial testing. Its range includes heating and drying ovens, incubators, climate chambers, water baths and environmental test chambers.
fullDescription: Memmert's official site documents temperature- and climate-control appliances for research, quality assurance and production support.

The portfolio includes universal and vacuum ovens, incubators, cooled incubators, constant-climate and humidity chambers, stability and environmental test chambers, water baths and related monitoring software.

profiles.shortDescription: MENNEKES develops and manufactures industrial plugs, sockets and electrical connection systems. Its portfolio also includes charging solutions for electric vehicles.
fullDescription: MENNEKES' official site documents electrical connection technology for machines, plants, distribution equipment and mobile applications.

The range includes standardized industrial plugs and receptacles, switched and interlocked sockets, combination units, power-distribution products, custom connection solutions and AC charging equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Menzel Elektromotoren manufactures and configures industrial electric motors for demanding drive applications. Its range includes low-, medium- and high-voltage, slip-ring, DC and special-purpose motors.
fullDescription: Menzel Elektromotoren's official site documents industrial motor engineering, production, adaptation and testing.

The portfolio covers squirrel-cage and slip-ring induction motors, medium- and high-voltage motors, DC motors, marine and explosion-protected versions, frequency-converter-duty motors and application-specific replacement machines.

profiles.shortDescription: Mercotac manufactures rotating electrical connectors that transfer power and signals across rotating interfaces. Its products use liquid-metal contact technology as an alternative to conventional slip rings.
fullDescription: Mercotac's official site documents compact rotary electrical connectors for continuous or intermittent rotation.
The range includes single- and multi-conductor connectors, coaxial and high-current configurations, mounting accessories and models for signal, instrumentation and power-transfer applications.

profiles.shortDescription: MERKES develops and manufactures compact synchronous servo motors and high-efficiency industrial motors. Its range includes configurable servo motors, permanent-magnet motors and reluctance-hybrid motors.
fullDescription: MERKES' official site documents motor production for automation, machine building and variable-speed applications.

The portfolio includes synchronous servo motors, IE4 and IE5 permanent-magnet motors, reluctance-hybrid motors and customer-specific winding and mechanical configurations for small and medium production series.

profiles.shortDescription: Merkle develops and manufactures manual and automated welding equipment. Its range covers MIG/MAG, TIG, plasma and robotic welding systems, torches and process-control software.
fullDescription: Merkle's official company profile identifies a German welding-technology manufacturer founded in 1964.

The published portfolio includes MIG/MAG, pulse and TIG power sources, plasma welding and cutting equipment, manual and machine torches, turntables, automation modules, complete robotic cells and welding-process software.

profiles.shortDescription: Mersen develops electrical protection, power-management and advanced-material solutions for industrial systems. Its range includes fuses, surge protection, power electronics cooling, carbon brushes and graphite process equipment.
fullDescription: Mersen's official corporate site documents two complementary areas: electrical power and advanced materials.

The portfolio covers fuses and fusegear, surge-protection devices, bus bars, power-electronics cooling, carbon brushes and current-transfer systems, graphite heat exchangers and components for corrosive chemical processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Messag designs and builds conveying and process equipment for bulk and pasty materials. Its systems cover transport, dosing, mixing, cooling, heating, screening and extraction.
fullDescription: Messag's official site identifies a Swiss manufacturer of material-conveying machinery and engineered systems.
The portfolio includes tube, trough, shaftless and twin-shaft screw conveyors, screw elevators, dosing feeders and hoppers, mixers, cooling and heating screws, silos and customized process equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Messer Cutting Systems develops machines, software and process technology for thermal cutting. Its portfolio covers oxyfuel, plasma and laser systems, material handling and production management.
fullDescription: Messer Cutting Systems' official site documents equipment for automated cutting of sheet, plate, pipes and profiles.

The range includes oxyfuel, plasma and laser cutting machines, drilling and marking options, extraction and material-handling systems, controls, nesting and production software, and service for complete cutting installations.

profiles.shortDescription: Meta Vision Systems develops laser-vision sensors and controls for automated welding. Its products support seam tracking, joint-profile measurement and remote monitoring of welding processes.
fullDescription: Meta Vision Systems' official site and manufacturer documents identify an Oxfordshire-based vision-system producer focused on welding automation.

The portfolio includes digital laser scanners, seam-tracking sensors, weld cameras, remote-view systems and controls that guide or monitor submerged-arc, robotic and other mechanised welding operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Metabo develops and manufactures professional power tools and accessories. Its range covers drilling, fastening, grinding, cutting, sawing, woodworking and cordless workshop applications.
fullDescription: Metabo's official site documents corded, cordless and pneumatic tools for professional construction and industrial work.

The portfolio includes drills and rotary hammers, screwdrivers, angle and straight grinders, saws, metalworking and woodworking machines, dust extraction, compressors, batteries and system accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Metrix develops vibration monitoring and protection instruments for rotating machinery. Its range includes vibration switches, transmitters, sensors, monitors and proximity measurement systems.
fullDescription: Metrix's official site documents machinery-protection instrumentation for pumps, motors, fans, compressors, turbines and other rotating assets.
The portfolio includes mechanical and electronic vibration switches, seismic transmitters, velocity and acceleration sensors, proximity probes, signal conditioners and rack-based monitoring systems.

profiles.shortDescription: METROL manufactures precision positioning sensors for machine tools, robots and automated equipment. Its range includes touch switches, tool setters, touch probes, air-gap sensors and breakage-detection sensors.
fullDescription: METROL's official site identifies a Japanese manufacturer specialising in contact-based precision positioning sensors.

The product range covers touch switches for jigs and machinery, tool setters for machining centres and lathes, touch probes, pneumatic air-gap sensors, drill-breakage detection and sensors for demanding temperature, vacuum and contamination conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: Meyer Industries was a manufacturer of sanitary conveying and bulk-handling equipment that became part of PFI. Its legacy product scope includes vibratory conveyors, bucket elevators and food-process material handling.
fullDescription: PFI's official company history confirms that Meyer Industries was founded in 1945, moved into food conveying and was later merged with KOFAB and rebranded as PFI.
The current official PFI surface continues to reference legacy Meyer Industries equipment within sanitary belt, bucket, horizontal-motion, vibratory conveying and bulk-product handling solutions.
